name: Fresh Rainbow Trout Fillet (Skinless, Oven-Baked)
whyItWorks: Freshwater trout has an exceptionally fine, tender flake and delivers anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats with very low connective tissue. Mild and soothing on sensitive stomachs.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake skinless trout fillet in a toaster oven at 375°F for 8–10 minutes with olive oil and sea salt.
